alexcrichton opened PR #14415 from alexcrichton:charge-more-fuel to bytecodealliance:main:

In addition to the previous charges made for types like lists and maps this commit additionally changes for allocations done in records, structs, enums, etc. The goal of this commit is to ensure that allocations made on the host on behalf of guests are generally as aligned-as-possible with the fuel tracking.
